# Observra

> Framework-agnostic agent behavior analytics. Observra captures every
> meaningful AI agent action — token usage, tool calls, cost, errors — as
> CIM-normalized telemetry, with zero custom instrumentation per agent.
> Open source (Apache-2.0), published to PyPI as `observra`, maintained by
> the Open Agent and AI Security Community (Exabeam-sponsored).

Observra answers three questions for any AI agent, on any framework: what
happened, how much did it cost, and was it normal? An adapter for the host
framework feeds events into a non-blocking queue; a background worker drains
them to one or more backends (JSONL, webhook, OpenTelemetry spans/logs, or a
SIEM), normalized to a single Common Information Model (CIM) event schema so
the same query works regardless of which framework produced the agent's
actions.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://open-agent-ai-security.github.io/observra/guide/index.html): what Observra is and how the pieces fit together
- [Architecture](https://open-agent-ai-security.github.io/observra/guide/architecture.html): capture → queue → backend pipeline
- [Event Schema](https://open-agent-ai-security.github.io/observra/guide/event-schema.html): the CIM event contract every adapter normalizes to
- [Production Deployment](https://open-agent-ai-security.github.io/observra/guide/production-deployment.html): backends, OTel export, operational guidance
- [Compatibility](https://open-agent-ai-security.github.io/observra/guide/COMPATIBILITY.html): supported Python and framework versions
- [API Reference](https://open-agent-ai-security.github.io/observra/guide/api/index.html): auto-generated reference for the public Python SDK
